scams.name: Yogyakarta Malioboro Batik Gallery Commission Scam
scams.description: Jalan Malioboro — Yogyakarta's main tourist spine — hosts the city's single most-documented 2025 tourist scam. 2025 community reports ('How we got scammed in Yogyakarta today') describe the pattern: a friendly English-speaking local approaches near the Kraton or Malioboro saying 'Today is special batik exhibition, last day, government art school, come see.' Other 2025 reports ('So many scams in Yogyakarta') note tourists are walked 5–15 minutes off-Malioboro to a 'gallery' that is actually a commission shop where a 'teacher' or 'artist' aggressively sells mass-produced batik at 3–10x fair prices (claimed 'silk painted art' at Rp 3M–15M / US$200–$950 that is actually cotton print worth Rp 200K–500K). The variants: (a) 'today only cultural performance' where the real goal is the batik-shop stop afterwards; (b) 'my sister/friend makes traditional batik, come see her atelier' (no real atelier, just a commission warehouse); (c) 'school for orphans, proceeds go to charity' (fake charity front); (d) becak driver offering 'Yogya tour 50K' who detours to a commission batik shop. Community reports note the broader Javanese tourist-pricing context, and 2025 community reports document the ongoing frustration and calls for government action. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) IGNORE every 'batik exhibition today only' or 'government art show' approach on Malioboro or near the Kraton — there is NO legitimate free batik exhibition; (2) buy batik at fair prices from Beringharjo Market (ground floor, north wing) where haggling starts at 30–50% of the opening quote, or from Batik Plentong (Jalan Tirtodipuran) which is a reputable workshop with posted prices; (3) for authentic tulis (hand-drawn) batik at fair price, visit Winotosastro Batik Tulis (Jalan Tirtodipuran) with published certification; (4) refuse every 'becak tour 50K' offer — always a commission trap; (5) if walked to a 'gallery' under any pretence, leave immediately and never feel obligated to buy; (6) 2025 community reports titled 'How we got scammed in Yogyakarta today' are worth reading before your trip.
scams.avoidance: IGNORE every 'batik exhibition today only' approach on Malioboro/Kraton Buy batik at Beringharjo Market ground floor or Batik Plentong posted-price For authentic tulis batik, visit Winotosastro Batik Tulis with certification Refuse every becak 'Yogya tour 50K' offer Leave any 'gallery' walked to under pretence; no obligation to buy
scams.location: Jalan Malioboro (main tourist street), Sultan's Palace (Kraton) exits, Taman Sari Water Castle approach, Beringharjo Market surroundings

scams.name: Yogyakarta Airport (YIA/JOG) Taxi & Kulon Progo Transfer Overcharge
scams.description: Yogyakarta's airport situation changed in 2020 when most flights moved from central Adisutjipto (JOG) to the new Yogyakarta International Airport (YIA) at Kulon Progo — 45 km southwest of central Yogya, a 60–75 minute drive. 2025 community reports cover the airport-transfer challenge, and community discussions document the specific Kulon Progo tourist-transfer overcharge problem. The scam: airport 'premium taxi' kiosks quote Rp 500K–900K (US$30–$55) for the YIA-to-central-Yogya transfer, while the legitimate fare is Rp 250K–350K via Grab or the DAMRI airport shuttle bus (Rp 50K–75K, 90 min with stops). A secondary 2025 scam is the YIA-to-Borobudur direct tout: drivers at the arrivals exit offer 'direct to Borobudur, skip Yogya' at Rp 1.5M–2.5M (US$95–$155), knowing fresh tourists don't know the real rate. Legitimate Grab or pre-booked Klook YIA-to-Borobudur is Rp 600K–800K (US$40–$50). Old Adisutjipto (JOG) has its own legacy taxi mafia though fewer international flights use it now. Community reports document broader Javanese airport-tout pressure. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) book Grab or Gojek yourself on airport Wi-Fi AFTER luggage — typical fare YIA-to-central-Yogya is Rp 250K–350K, 60–75 min; (2) for budget, use the DAMRI airport shuttle bus from YIA arrivals to central Yogya (Rp 75K, 90 min, runs every 30 min 5 AM–9 PM); (3) for YIA-to-Borobudur direct transfer (recommended if sunrise tour booked), pre-book via Klook at Rp 600K–800K; (4) IGNORE every 'premium taxi' kiosk and sign-holder at arrivals; (5) if staying at Adisutjipto (JOG) arrivals (domestic flights), same Grab protocol; Grab pickup zone is outside terminal exit; (6) allow buffer time — Yogya traffic on the ring road (ringroad selatan) adds 30–60 min at peak 7–9 AM and 4–6 PM.
scams.avoidance: Book Grab/Gojek on airport Wi-Fi — typical fare YIA-Yogya Rp 250K–350K Budget option: DAMRI airport shuttle bus Rp 75K, 90 min, every 30 min For YIA-to-Borobudur direct, pre-book Klook at Rp 600K–800K IGNORE every 'premium taxi' kiosk and arrivals sign-holder Allow buffer for Yogya ring-road traffic at 7–9 AM / 4–6 PM
scams.location: Yogyakarta International Airport (YIA/Kulon Progo, opened 2020), old Adisutjipto Airport (JOG, now limited operations), airport exit kerb, Kulon Progo shuttle-bus stop

scams.name: Yogyakarta Becak & Andong Pedicab 'Free Tour' Commission Scam
scams.description: Yogyakarta's becak (three-wheeled cycle rickshaw) and andong (horse-drawn carriage) touts run one of Indonesia's most-entrenched tourist-commission networks. 2025 community reports document the becak as the VEHICLE of the Malioboro batik scam — the driver is a paid commission agent. The standard 'free tour' pitch: 'Only 20,000 rupiah, 2 hours, all places, I show you my city' — the Rp 20K stated fare is the cover story; the real business is the commission kickback (30–50%) from any 'silver workshop', 'batik gallery', or 'herbal medicine shop' the driver forcibly detours to. 2025 reports document the becak pattern specifically: drivers spend 10 minutes on 'cultural' stops and 40 minutes at commission shops; attempts to cut the tour short are met with 'one more stop, quick, very quick' and pressure. The andong horse-carriage variant is slightly more expensive (Rp 50K–100K stated) and also commission-driven. A 2025 variant: 'Jogja Dragon Tour' or 'Sultanate heritage tour' with printed brochures — also fake, same commission structure. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) refuse EVERY becak/andong tour offer on Malioboro — never negotiate, never 'see what happens'; legitimate becaks for short point-to-point transfers cost Rp 20K–30K per km and are fine for known single-destination trips; (2) for sightseeing, walk Malioboro on foot (1 km length) and take Grab/Gojek for transfers between Kraton, Taman Sari, and Borobudur day trips; (3) if you want a guided tour, book through a licensed operator via Klook, Viator, or your hotel concierge (Rp 300K–600K per person for half-day, published itinerary); (4) for authentic andong rides, take the tourist loop at the Alun-Alun Utara (North Square) facing the Kraton — fixed-price Rp 50K per 15-min ride with no commission stops; (5) community reports give pricing guidance for bargaining.
scams.avoidance: REFUSE every becak/andong tour offer on Malioboro; walk on foot Use Grab/Gojek for transfers between Kraton, Taman Sari, Borobudur trips For guided tours, book licensed operators via Klook, Viator, or hotel For authentic andong, take fixed-price loop at Alun-Alun Utara (Rp 50K / 15 min) Becaks for single-destination point-to-point: Rp 20K–30K per km only
scams.location: Malioboro Street length, Sultan's Palace (Kraton) exits, Taman Sari Water Castle, Alun-Alun Selatan (South Square), Beringharjo Market corners

scams.name: Borobudur Temple Sunrise Fake-Ticket & Manohara Upsell Scam
scams.description: Borobudur — UNESCO 9th-century Buddhist temple, Indonesia's most-visited monument — has one of Asia's most-tangled 2025 ticketing situations, and scammers exploit the confusion aggressively. The legitimate structure (post-2023 reforms): standard daytime entry Rp 455,000 for foreigners (includes upper-terrace stupa access with guide + sandal protection); sunrise entry is ONLY available via Manohara Resort sunrise programme at Rp 600K–800K (package includes pre-dawn torch, tea, breakfast, guide) OR via Punthuk Setumbu hill viewpoint (Rp 50K, self-arranged, NOT inside temple). Community reports establish the baseline on the pricing controversy. The 2025 scams exploiting this complexity: (a) 'skip-the-line Borobudur sunrise' tickets sold online at Rp 1.5M–2.5M (US$95–$155) via fake sites — these are either fake or just re-sold Manohara tickets with Rp 700K markup; (b) tour-operator 'sunrise exclusive access' at Rp 2M that's actually just Punthuk Setumbu hill viewpoint (Rp 50K real price) plus a bus; (c) local fixers at temple entrance offering 'private stupa access, tip 500K' — upper-terrace access is ONLY via official guide rotation and NEVER by tip. Community reports document the 2022 temple-closure crisis that permanently changed access rules, and 2025 reports document sunrise-ticket fraud specifically. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) book ONLY via Manohara Resort official site (manoharaborobudur.com) for the sunrise programme at Rp 600K–800K direct; (2) for daytime entry, buy at the official Borobudur ticket office OR via tiket.com / Traveloka at Rp 455K; (3) if wanting the Instagram sunrise photo WITHOUT temple access, go to Punthuk Setumbu hill viewpoint at Rp 50K (arrange Grab driver to wait); (4) upper-terrace stupa access is INCLUDED in the standard ticket (post-2022 reform) — no extra tip needed; (5) refuse every 'private access' or 'skip-the-line' upgrade offered at entrance; (6) wear respectful clothing (shoulders/knees covered) — sarong provided by temple is included; (7) the Borobudur + Prambanan combo ticket at Rp 680K exists legitimately on tiket.com and saves Rp 180K vs separate purchases.
scams.avoidance: Book sunrise ONLY via manoharaborobudur.com — Rp 600K–800K direct Buy daytime tickets at Borobudur office OR tiket.com/Traveloka — Rp 455K For sunrise photo without temple, go to Punthuk Setumbu hill at Rp 50K Upper-terrace stupa access is INCLUDED — no tips, no 'private access' Combo Borobudur+Prambanan at Rp 680K on tiket.com saves Rp 180K
scams.location: Borobudur Temple (Magelang, 40 km NW of Yogya), Manohara Resort pre-dawn entry point, Punthuk Setumbu sunrise hill, Kulon Progo approach road

scams.name: Prambanan Temple 'Mandatory Guide' & Skip-the-Line Fraud
scams.description: Prambanan — UNESCO 9th-century Hindu temple complex, the second Yogyakarta UNESCO must-see — has a parallel scam ecosystem to Borobudur but centred on 'mandatory guide' fraud. The legitimate ticket: Rp 375K foreigner entry (post-2023), INCLUDES all three main temples (Shiva, Vishnu, Brahma) and optional smaller Sewu/Plaosan satellite temples. NO guide is required — printed self-guided brochures are free at the office. Community reports document the Javanese 'foreigner pricing' controversy that applies to Prambanan too. The 2025 scams: (a) fixers at the ticket-office exit claiming 'guide is mandatory for foreigners, Rp 300K' — untrue; a guide is OPTIONAL and if desired costs Rp 150K–250K for a licensed Prambanan office guide; (b) 'skip-the-line' ticket sold online at Rp 600K–900K — Prambanan has no real queue to skip and no official 'skip-the-line' tier exists; (c) 'Ramayana Ballet combo' packages at Rp 800K+ including 'dinner' where the dinner is Rp 50K street food near the theatre and the ballet is Rp 300K–500K direct at the box office; (d) becak drivers at the Prambanan gate offering 'I wait for you 4 hours, 100K' then demanding Rp 400K+ after the wait. 2025 community reports document Prambanan-specific 'mandatory guide' pressure. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) buy Prambanan entry at the official ticket office for Rp 375K OR via tiket.com/Traveloka (same price); (2) REFUSE every 'mandatory guide' claim — no guide is required, printed self-guided maps are free; (3) if you want a guide, hire ONLY at the official tourism desk (Rp 150K–250K) — they wear numbered official badges; (4) for the Ramayana Ballet (highly recommended, Tuesday–Saturday dry season), book direct at prambananjazz.com or the box office at Rp 300K–500K (not 'combo' packages); (5) Prambanan + Borobudur combo ticket at Rp 680K is legitimate on tiket.com (saves Rp 150K); (6) use Grab/Gojek for transfer to Prambanan entrance — becak rides and 'wait for you' deals are commission-padded; (7) the best sunset viewing spot is the outer park lawn (free, included in entry) — no 'premium sunset access' exists.
scams.avoidance: Buy entry at Prambanan office OR tiket.com — Rp 375K, NO mandatory guide If wanting a guide, hire ONLY at official tourism desk — Rp 150K–250K badged Book Ramayana Ballet direct at prambananjazz.com — Rp 300K–500K Combo Borobudur+Prambanan at Rp 680K on tiket.com saves Rp 150K Use Grab/Gojek for transfer; refuse 'wait for you' becak deals
scams.location: Prambanan Temple complex (Klaten, 17 km NE of Yogya), entrance ticket office, Prambanan archaeological park gate, Ramayana Ballet outdoor theatre

scams.name: Mount Merapi Jeep Lava Tour Unlicensed Operator & Overcharge
scams.description: The 'Merapi Lava Jeep Tour' — open-top 4x4 tour of the 2010 eruption-devastated zone on Mount Merapi's south slope — is Yogyakarta's most-popular half-day adventure but hosts a 2025 unlicensed-operator problem. The legitimate price: Rp 450K–650K per jeep (up to 4 people) for the 'short route' (2 hours: Bunker Kaliadem + Museum Sisa Hartaku + Mini Merapi Museum + Alien Stone photo stop); Rp 600K–900K for the 'long route' (3.5 hours, adds Kali Kuning river-crossing + higher lookouts). 2025 community reports document Merapi tour pricing. The 2025 scams: (a) unlicensed jeep operators at the Kaliurang base offering 'VIP route Rp 1.5M' that is just the standard short route at 2.5x price; (b) hotel concierges in Yogya city selling 'Merapi sunrise tour Rp 1.2M per person' (including transport) where the real jeep is Rp 500K per 4 people and the hotel pockets Rp 3M+ per booking; (c) fake-insurance upcharges 'safety fee Rp 200K per person' at the base (there is no legitimate safety fee — jeeps are insured as part of the operator's licence); (d) missing safety gear on unlicensed jeeps — no helmets, no seatbelts, aggressive driving for 'adventure photos' that causes injuries. 2025 community reports document tour-operator overcharge specifically for Merapi. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) book DIRECT at the Kaliurang jeep tour associations (Merapi Jeep Community or Lava Tour Kaliurang) at Rp 450K–650K per jeep — jeeps are assigned on arrival; (2) if booking via hotel/tour operator, cap budget at Rp 1M per jeep all-in (not per person) INCLUDING Yogya transfer; (3) verify licence: operator should have an 'IJK Merapi' sticker + numbered plate + printed fare schedule at the booth; (4) INSIST on helmet and seatbelt before departing; do not accept 'no helmet needed'; (5) refuse any 'VIP route' upsell above Rp 650K for short / Rp 900K for long — these are scams; (6) Merapi jeeps do NOT climb the active cone (2010 disaster-zone tourism only) — any operator claiming 'summit' is illegal; (7) sunrise timing is 5–5:30 AM; aim to leave Yogya by 4 AM for short route; (8) for older travellers with back problems, the short route is very bumpy — confirm with operator before booking.
scams.avoidance: Book direct at Kaliurang jeep associations — Rp 450K–650K per jeep (4 people) Hotel-booked package cap: Rp 1M per jeep all-in INCLUDING transfer Verify 'IJK Merapi' licence sticker + numbered plate + fare schedule INSIST on helmet + seatbelt before departure No jeep goes to active cone — refuse any 'summit' claim
scams.location: Kaliurang / Kinahrejo (Mount Merapi base, 25 km N of Yogya), Bunker Kaliadem, Museum Sisa Hartaku, Mini Merapi Museum approach road
